title: CKB transaction flow — strict numbered format with Gotchas
prompt:
Write a CKB transaction flow in exactly these steps, each as a numbered item, each under 20 words:
(1) UTXO selection
(2) Output construction
(3) Fee calculation
(4) Witness generation
(5) Serialisation
(6) Broadcast

Then add a 'Gotchas' section with exactly 3 bullet points about common mistakes developers make when building CKB transactions.

Rules:
- Each numbered step must be UNDER 20 words (count them)
- The Gotchas section must have EXACTLY 3 bullet points (no more, no less)
- Use the heading '## Gotchas' for that section
- No other sections or text
